findings.description: The plugin's native denial of the crafting table is not logged as an explicit decision: the Bukkit-level ATD_W2_INPUT_EVENT/ATD_EVENT lines say useBlock=ALLOW, cancelled=false even in locked rows. The denial is inferred from the absence of INVENTORY_OPEN/ClientboundOpenScreenPacket plus the client overlay; sufficient, but a reader could misread the ALLOW line as an allowed action.
